items.title: UNP Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Volume Growth, Pricing Gains
items.summary: Union Pacific (UNP) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.53 per share, beating consensus by 1.7%, with revenues rising 15.3% to $7.20 billion. Freight revenues grew 14.9% driven by higher carloads and pricing gains, though fuel expenses surged 68.8%. The company maintains high-single-digit EPS growth outlook for 2026. Other transportation companies showed mixed results: Alaska Air Group beat earnings estimates but faced fuel headwinds, Wabtec beat earnings but missed revenue targets, and J.B. Hunt exceeded both earnings and revenue expectations.
